select s.id, s.user_id as userId, s.student_no as studentNo, s.university_id as universityId, u.name as universityName, s.college_id as collegeId, c.name as collegeName, s.major_id as majorId, m.name as majorName, s.class_id as classId, cl.name as className, s.entry_year as entryYear, s.bind_status as bindStatus, us.real_name as realName, us.avatar as avatar, us.gender as gender from students s left join universities u on s.university_id = u.id left join sys_dept c on s.college_id = c.id left join sys_dept m on s.major_id = m.id left join sys_dept cl on s.class_id = cl.id left join user us on s.user_id = us.id where s.id = #{id}
